note: The whole of this product's scoring policy. Generated from Weights.Teaching and asserted to match it, so reading this is reading the code. One component, both measures inside it: the pressurable number cannot move without the counter-metric moving, which is METRIC-ETHICS.md section 2 and issue #18 section 4.5.
humanStateHeuristics: Absent from this table, and absent from the Measure enum it is generated from — not present at zero. Anything that guesses at a reader's state belongs outside the scoring engine entirely (METRIC-ETHICS.md section 4, issue #18 section 4.6). HumanStateIsNotAMeasureTests is what makes that structural rather than stated.

weights.because: Give the frame's answer away and this rises immediately. An author watching only this would read that as the frame improving.

A check resting on this frame and on a later one passes only if the reader still has this frame when they arrive, so giving the answer away cannot raise it and replacing teaching with a giveaway lowers it.
